delta.comment: Correction cycle 2 (HEAD 663205a6): two corrections to this operational-restatement carrier. (1) C1 test text now names all FIVE discriminators the authoritative C1 in 134.001-T declares insufficient -- 'related' was missing, leaving that discriminator free to be used as an in-scope justification, which is exactly the reasoning C1 exists to forbid. (2) C3 symmetric guard part (ii) now requires BOTH a captured entry AND a residual-risk record; this task previously required only the captured entry, but a captured entry with no residual-risk record still leaves the deferral undisclosed at closure, which is the gap the guard closes. Both changes align this restatement with the authoritative wording it restates; behaviour subsets B2 and B9 are unchanged.
